summary: Destruction Fire keeping its own Curse of the Elements (rank 4, 10% magic damage taken) up for the raid, with the raid's copy off. Under Forever the curse has its own slot, so the bane stays. Costs 9.5 DPS at 180s.
rotation: Life Tap below 5% mana or when Incinerate costs more than the mana left
Curse of the Elements on duty for the raid, right after the opener and recast before it drops
Bane of Doom when it lands before the fight ends (more than 60s left)
Bane of Agony while Bane of Doom is on cooldown or would not land
Corruption when down or under 2s left (more than 9s left)
Immolate when down or under 2s left (more than 6s left)
Conflagrate on cooldown while Immolate is up
Death Coil, then Searing Pain, when the filler would not land before the fight ends
caveats: Under Forever a bane and a curse use separate slots, so the duty curse costs only its GCDs and mana, not the bane.
Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets: 38 spell power and 13 crit rating, and an on-use 140 spell power for 20s every 2 min (at the pull, then on cooldown).
Demon sensitivity: no owner scaling 937.3, Succubus melee halved 937.4, both 913.2; without owner scaling the Succubus-sacrifice build (950.8) would be the pick (first set)
Firestone is 24 ahead of Spellstone. Felhunter is 25 behind, Imp 35.
Undead and Gnome are within noise at 180s. Undead is ahead at 300s.
Unverified: whether Incinerate's 25% bonus applies to the whole hit. Bane of Havoc's point does nothing.
Demon scaling uses Season of Discovery placeholder coefficients (Forever's are server side). Worth 49 on Demonology and 39 on the other builds.
Succubus base melee is unverified. Halving it would cost Demonology 43 and the other builds 38 to 39.
Bane of Doom's coefficient is 4.0 (Era 1.0), about 12% of Shadow Bolt builds' damage. At 2.0 they lose about 4%, at 1.0 about 6%.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Shadow Bolt IX, Immolate VII, Corruption VI). These are 7 to 13 DPS below ranks X, VIII and VII.
Only the Demonheart Raiment 2-piece is live (the 5-piece added about +8 to +13 on the first set)
Soul shards and Life Tap's health cost aren't tracked.
Demons use the warlock's spell crit as their own melee and spell crit, with no crit of their own (Blizzard's intent, forever-bugs #331). Worth 15 to 17 DPS.
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as warlock__destruction_fire except -apl level60_destruction_fire_duty_curse, then raid.debuffs.curseOfElements set to false. Demon Armor; Summon Succubus, sacrificed NoSummon, imbue Firestone. mksettings sets distanceFromTarget 5 / channelClipDelayMs 50 where the UI preset uses 25 / 150; the published numbers were made with mksettings and reproduce exactly.
